projects.name: Management (Citi - APAC Region) – Jun 2015 – Aug 2017
details: The project involved delivering regulatory and business initiatives across Citi's APAC card
platforms. Managed end-to-end project delivery for multiple regional implementations,
coordinating business, technology, and testing teams to ensure timely implementation of
regulatory and business-driven system changes.
Responsibilities
• Handling system implementation as per the regulatory and business requirement from various
regions after going through BRD (Business Requirement Document).
• Coordinating with stakeholders for getting the UAT and FUAT testing completed.
• Detailed Project planning and developing, like preparing a project plan, resources requirement,
and timeframe.
• Mastercard-related Cards/Payments programmes, giving him strong practical understanding of
the Mastercard ecosystem and card-payment lifecycle.
• Regulatory & scheme requirements: His Mastercard experience is highly relevant to the Capco
requirement around scheme mandates, regulatory changes, compliance requirements, and
implementation of changes across card platforms.
• Cards & Payments:
• Strong hands-on experience across the end-to-end credit-card lifecycle, including card issuance,
authorization, transaction processing, billing, payments, disputes and chargebacks, clearing,
settlement, and reconciliation. Experienced in VisionPLUS implementations, platform
migrations, testing, release management, and production deployments.
• Visa/Mastercard Regulatory & Compliance Releases:
• Managed Visa- and Mastercard-mandated regulatory and compliance changes as part of the
Fiserv–ANZ Release Management programme, covering scope consolidation, regulatory impact
assessment, release planning, risk and dependency management, SIT/UAT coordination, CAB
approvals, Go/No-Go readiness, production deployment, and post-implementation support.
• Mastercard Certification & EMV Migration:
• Hands-on experience with Mastercard certification activities during magnetic-stripe-to-EMV
chip-card migration programmes at TCS, including transaction validation, PIN-exchange
requirements, and white-plastic card certification activities prior to production rollout.
• End-to-end Cards expertise: Combined with his experience in credit cards, authorization,
disputes, settlement, reconciliation, AML/KYC and risk/control testing, he brings both Mastercard
domain knowledge and regulatory/risk expertise—which is exactly the combination Capco is
looking for.
• Managing project deliverables in line with the project plan.
• Risk Assessment and Risk analysis using through register and possible threats that will face in
the project.
• Global testing for Citi Product, reviewing Test Plan, strategy, Test Metrics.
• PVT - Insertion of transaction points, parameterization for Risk analytics and payments in cards.

projects.name: Money Laundering – Transactions Surveillance Unit – Apr 2014 – May 2015
details: The AML Transaction Surveillance Unit was responsible for monitoring financial transactions
to identify suspicious activities and ensure compliance with Anti-Money Laundering
regulations. As a Subject Matter Expert and Quality Assurance Manager, I managed quality
reviews, audit compliance, and continuous process improvement initiatives.
Responsibilities
• Managed internal audit and quality control reviews for AML case processing.
• Analyzed payment transactions for unusual activity.
• Reviewed CDD, EDD, public domain, and watchlist information.
• Conducted regular huddles to improve quality and decision-making.

projects.name: (North America Operations – Control Testing Unit) – Sep 2007-Apr 2014
details: The North America Operations Control Testing Unit was responsible for performing
operational risk and control testing across banking operations to ensure compliance with
regulatory requirements and internal control standards. Managed a team responsible for
audit execution, control testing, and client coordination.
Responsibilities
• Led a team of 9 members in risk and control self-assessment.
• Managed audits related to account opening, customer service, KYC/CDD, CTR, STR, settlements,
and dialer controls.
• Coordinated with clients to understand issues and provide solutions.
• Conducted meetings, shared process updates, and collected feedback.

details: The Disputes Analysis team was responsible for investigating customer disputes related to credit card transactions and processing chargebacks in accordance with card network
regulations. Worked closely with customers and merchants to resolve disputes while
ensuring compliance with American Express policies.
Responsibilities
• Handled customer disputes and chargeback investigations.
• Reviewed merchant evidence and customer claims.
• Issued credits, processed rebilling, and managed write-off decisions.
ACADEMIA

projects.name: (North America Operations – Control Testing Unit) – Sep 2007-Apr 2014
details: The North America Operations Control Testing Unit was responsible for performing
operational risk and control testing across banking operations to ensure compliance with
regulatory requirements and internal control standards. Managed a team responsible for
audit execution, control testing, and client coordination.
Responsibilities
• Led a team of 9 members in risk and control self-assessment.
• Managed audits related to account opening, customer service, KYC/CDD, CTR, STR, settlements,
and dialer controls.
• Coordinated with clients to understand issues and provide solutions.
• Conducted meetings, shared process updates, and collected feedback.

details: The Disputes Analysis team was responsible for investigating customer disputes related to credit card transactions and processing chargebacks in accordance with card network
regulations. Worked closely with customers and merchants to resolve disputes while
ensuring compliance with American Express policies.
